_readme: Copy to .llm-connector.json in your project (or ~/). Roles follow the deciding-vs-doing split: plan/verify get reasoning models, build/fast get cheap executors. Each role is an ORDERED fallback list: first entry preferred; entries whose API key env var is unset are skipped; on HTTP failure the next entry is tried. Never falls through across roles. Add providers by giving any Anthropic-compatible endpoint a baseUrl + apiKeyEnv.
